collections.name: Advaya Rituals - Full Size Products
collections.description: Our signature full-size collection of handcrafted personal care, created for everyday moments of self-care. From artisan cold-process soaps to hair, body and skincare, every Advaya Ritual is thoughtfully made with natural ingredients, nourishing oils, botanical extracts and beautiful fragrances. Handcrafted in small batches, consciously created, and designed to turn everyday care into a luxurious ritual.

collections.name: Advaya Basic Guest Kit
collections.description: A thoughtfully curated introduction to Advaya’s handcrafted self-care rituals. Designed for hotels, resorts and hospitality spaces, the Basic Guest Kit brings together essential mini-sized personal care products made with natural ingredients, botanical extracts and nourishing oils. Compact, elegant and easy to use, it adds a touch of conscious luxury to every guest stay.

collections.name: Advaya Premium Guest Kit
collections.description: An elevated guest experience featuring a curated selection of Advaya’s handcrafted personal care essentials in premium mini sizes. Thoughtfully formulated with natural ingredients, botanical goodness and rich fragrances, the Premium Guest Kit transforms everyday amenities into a luxurious self-care ritual—leaving guests with an experience worth remembering.
